summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. Existing human research is retained: inflammatory, oxidative and lipid biomarker meta-analyses with mixed results. All six declared sources are meta-analyses of surrogate biomarkers, with no cardiovascular clinical outcome. Full texts of 39872318 (6 RCTs, 533 T2DM patients: CRP and oxidative markers lower, IL-6/TNF null, low-very low certainty) and 36145131 (17 RCTs, 968 adults: modest TC/TG/LDL reductions, opposite LDL direction at >=500 mg/day) were verified; abstracts of 24111838 and 29305228 show no lipid effect and 39255906 judges reductions not clinically important. Dr. Pham rejected longevity and broad clinical-benefit claims, so the record becomes reference-only with approved no-credit contexts; this removes Evidence points from resveratrol products.
